notes: The schematic image was not readable; the wiring is inferred from the sketch pin defines: pin 5 = white LED (meeting room), pin 2 = RGB red, pin 3 = RGB blue, pin 4 = RGB green, plus GND.
The MKR ENV Shield is stacked on the MKR WiFi 1010. It is modelled as a new part type that passes pins 2-5 and GND through, so jumper wires attach to its top sockets.
Each LED has a 220 ohm series resistor. The RGB LED is common cathode; its COM leg goes to the ground rail.
Breadboard hole positions (columns, ground rail holes) are assumptions; only the electrical connectivity comes from the tutorial.
Alexa, Arduino Cloud and the Cloud Editor steps are software only and are not modelled. The ENV shield's I2C sensor use does not add any wiring.
